portal_description:
The python-pycparser package contains a complete parser for the C programming language and an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) generator written in Python. The module can be easily integrated into applications that need to parse C source code.

This enhancement update adds the python-pycparser package to Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7. (BZ#1224321)

All users who require python-pycparser are advised to install this new package.

abstract:
The python-pycparser package contains a complete parser for the C programming language and an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) generator written in Python. The module can be easily integrated into applications that need to parse C source code.

This enhancement update adds the python-pycparser package to Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7. (BZ#1224321)

All users who require python-pycparser are advised to install this new package.
